metadata: Separate npy arrays, or an explicit original-label field index
splits: Supply separate train, val, test npy files; no automatic paper split is asserted
model_selection: Training labels define classes; validation F1 selects epoch; test evaluated once
contrastive_reduction: Half the mean margin loss over all unordered non-self sample pairs
contrastive_equation_N: The number of selected pairs, P = batch_size * (batch_size - 1) / 2
